program.name: Steady
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Everyday balance: one-leg stands, reaches and slow single-leg strength, then abs.
program.about: Everyday balance for steadier feet and fewer wobbles. A circuit alternates still balance, like one-leg stands and heel-to-toe walking, with moving balance, like reaches and knee lifts. A little single-leg strength and abs follow. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations. A wall nearby is always allowed.
